selected_nonstructural_evidence.evidence: SPR affinities and receptor specificity mutation study; BMP3 structure alone is 2QCQ.
Binding panel tested both ligands; binding outcome is ligand–receptor-specific.
Receptor involvement from cell signaling and knockdown assays.
2025 hepatic stellate cell study reports receptor binding and signaling.

nonstructural_evidence_scope: Selected positive examples, not a systematic literature audit of all 75 pairwise combinations. BMP5 and unlisted individual pairings remain unassessed here; do not label them no-data.

search_definitions.uniprot: gene_exact:<gene> AND reviewed:true; BMP9 includes GDF2 alias; bacterial BMP7 accession removed.
